finding: 3 csoai HF datasets have viewer:false; the tracker listed 2 and missed provbench (the flagship).

csoai/provbench.cause: RuntimeError: Dataset scripts are no longer supported, but found provbench.py
csoai/provbench.why_not_delete: README.md lists `provbench.py` as 'The full measurement harness (reproducible)' and the arXiv preprint points at it twice. Deleting it breaks the README table and removes the artifact the paper cites.
csoai/provbench.why_rename_works: HF only treats a script named after the dataset (<repo>.py) as a loading script. Renaming breaks that association; the file stays, the viewer unblocks.
csoai/provbench.risk: none — file retained, only its filename changes; update the README table row to match.

csoai/govbench.fix: Replace repo contents with evidence/harness/freeze/latest/govbench-items.jsonl (193 rows, 1 schema)
csoai/govbench.note: The repo holds RUN OUTPUTS, not the benchmark. nvidia_leaderboard.json holds ONE record (meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct) under an NVIDIA-implying filename and must not become the public face.

csoai/aiact-frozen-split-harness.cause: CastError — schema uses MODEL NAMES AS STRUCT KEYS (models."sov33-unified:latest".n_scored)
csoai/aiact-frozen-split-harness.fix: Reshape to long form: one row per (model, metric, value). A wide schema keyed by model name can never share a schema across files.
csoai/aiact-frozen-split-harness.shape: 24 rows, 15 models, 2 runs, ONE schema (16 fields)
csoai/aiact-frozen-split-harness.fidelity: 156 field comparisons against both source files: every value matches, 0 models dropped
csoai/aiact-frozen-split-harness.note: 12 of 24 rows carry an explicit `unmeasured` count — the honest-measurement discipline is already IN this data. The wide schema was hiding it: keyed by model name, the field was a struct member nobody could query. In long form it is a column you can filter on.

separate_defect_found.what: PROVBENCH_ARXIV_PREPRINT_2026-07-30.md cites the harness as `~/clawd/csoai-static-deploy2/provbench.py` — a local laptop path — in a PUBLIC preprint.
separate_defect_found.impact: Not reproducible by any reader, and it leaks a local filesystem layout into a research artifact whose selling point is reproducibility.
separate_defect_found.fix: Cite the HF repo path or a permalinked commit URL instead.
